text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan safely makes her Debut. Her 
social media comments are buzzing, but her 
joy at all the support is short-lived...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Noticing that most fans aren't interested 
in "Curren the Runner," Curren Chan feels 
the need to draw more attention during 
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, without setting an immediate 
target race, it was decided to focus on 
raising the profile of 'Cute Curren Chan' 
for a while.
